_comment_distance_threshold: Fixed 2026-10: distance_threshold is now per-dataset (moved out of defaults), set so both datasets use roughly the same physical neighbourhood (~14.28um), not the same pixel count. IMMUcan: 14.28px at the project's long-standing ~1um/px assumption (never independently confirmed -- see HANDOFF). cHL: 31.73px = 14.28um / 0.45um/px, where 0.45um/px is Julia's figure (not independently verifiable from this dataset's files -- no PhysicalSize in the OME-XML, no real TIFF resolution tag, only a placeholder XResolution=(1,1)). The segmentation folder name's 'mpp1.75' was considered and NOT used here -- it most likely describes a segmentation-model target resolution, not the raw acquisition mpp, but this was never independently confirmed either.

immucan._comment_excluded_channels: Channel indices follow CellTypes/channels.txt's line order exactly (0-indexed): 1=HistoneH3, 38=DNA1, 39=DNA2 -- same nuclear/housekeeping exclusion as every other method. The previous [0, 1, 2] excluded MPO/HistoneH3/SMA instead (two real phenotypic markers dropped, DNA1/DNA2 kept) -- checked against channels.txt directly and fixed.
immucan._comment_label_map: Raw cells2labels/*.txt integers checked directly against quantification/processed/IMMUcan_quantification.csv's (sample_id, cell_id) -> cell_type strings for a full image -- matches CellTypes/labels_cell_type.csv's mapping exactly. The previous map here used a different, non-matching order (e.g. 4 was read as CD4+_T_cell instead of Cancer) and silently mislabeled every class.

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_excluded_markers: Must match the exact filenames under single_channel_dir / lines in markers.txt -- 'anti-H2AX' alone (no suffix) silently fails to match 'anti-H2AX (pS139)' and would NOT be excluded. Fixed 2026-09-23.
